title: Device and method for transferring electronic components from a first carrier to a second carrier

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: The reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or a suction plate.

The reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, which includes a gripping device, but not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device in this context.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components and does not mention any sound-damping device or grip portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components and does not mention any sound-damping material or grip portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components and does not mention a vacuum generating device or housing portions in the context of a grip unit.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components and does not mention a sound-reducing device or sound-reducing material in any housing portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, not a grip unit with housing portions and an air outlet.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, not a grip unit with an air collection device or an air collection screw.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for transferring electronic components, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air away from it.
This reference does not mention air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.

claims.quote: A device for transferring electronic components from a first carrier to a second carrier.
claims.note: The abstract describes a device for transferring electronic components, which can be considered a type of handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a device for transferring components between carriers, but does not teach or mention a vacuum handling apparatus.

claims.note: This reference does not describe a suction plate with a carrier plate and a seal fastened to it.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference does not mention a grip unit, suction plate, or a coupling device for releasably connecting them.
This reference does not describe a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: This reference describes a device and method for transferring electronic components using slides and carriers, which is unrelated to a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip portion and sound-damping features.
